amendments: ACCESS_AMENDMENTS.json: dated, committed additions of entry points, each before its first use
gate: no label read before the registration files are committed and their sanitized public receipt is verified on the GitHub remote (tsz.receipt; REGISTRATION_RECEIPT_VERIFIED.json, write-once)
layer: tsz.common.load (the single logged label-access layer; every read appends one line to .private/<campaign>/access/LABEL_ACCESS.jsonl)
model_fit_rows: MODEL_FIT labels are released only for the rows of the requested registered subset (S50_O<o>, S70_O<o>, S100); select_ncv only on S100 (the estimator separates training and held-out rows inside each outer fold)
never: SEX as a runtime input or output
MODEL_SELECT in any fit, calibrator or strength rule

benchmark.what: original-benchmark utility (24 clauses + 4 guards), the development reserve, paired size contrasts, the registered task-stage trigger, realized costs of selected releases (never a strength-rule input)

calibrate.what: the A1_PO_16 diagnostic temperature on CALIBRATION (recorded, never applied, as in the source)

fit.what: task learning on a registered subset (A1_PO_16; T_TREE income / occupation teachers; Stage B TASK_REFIT, whose warm critics read SEX as in the source loop); full-pool correction fitting on S100 (witness cross-fitting base, routing, CONT / LOC / PAIR critics with SEX as a training label)

readers.what: fresh development reader grid (FIT / VALIDATION / SCORE reader roles inside MODEL_SELECT)

select_ncv.what: nested 10-fold household cross-fitting of the conditional strength rule: every upstream layer refitted on 90%, out-of-fold incremental task and within-SEX costs on the held-out 10% (fitting information only)

verify.what: independent verifier replay with separate metric, subset and selection code

sex_uses: training label on MODEL_FIT: Stage B warm critics of the TASK_REFIT control (unused by its objective), the CONT / LOC / PAIR correction critics
out-of-fold within-SEX cost estimates of the nested strength rule on MODEL_FIT (fitting information)
evaluation label on MODEL_SELECT: within-SEX occupation guards, development readers
